in_sanskrit.name: Oshina
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of fertility
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Oshina एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Oshina is the goddess of fertility, agriculture, and the harvest. She is often depicted as a nurturing mother and protector of life.
